rows.text: when `rcx` or its first qword is null, returns `edx` if non-negative, else 0; otherwise, reading through that qword, replaces `edx` in sequence: -1 by sign-extended word `+0x52`, then -2 by sign-extended word `+0x78`, then -3 by sign-extended word `+0x7A` (each test applied to the value left by the previous step), then any value still negative by sign-extended word `+0x52`, and returns the result if non-negative, else 0

notes: 00264CE0: the -1/-2/-3 tests are cascaded, not exclusive arms (a +0x52 value of -2 is replaced again by +0x78). The final cmovns clamps a negative result to 0 on every path, including the null path.
